newsitem.title: USA: Mills gets financing for Ontario Mills.
newsitem.headline: Mills gets financing for Ontario Mills.

text.p: Mills Corp said on Friday that HYPO Bank has provided permanent financing for the company's recently opened Ontario Mills shopping center.

Ontario Mills, which is located about 40 miles outside Los Angeles, holds 1.2 million square feet of gross leasable area that will be expanded to 1.7 million upon completion of anchor store construction over the next two years, Mills said.
The $120 millionr secured financing closed February 7, 1997 and matures in February 2002 with two one-year extension options, the developer of malls said.

Mills Corp said it has the option of selecting a variable or fixed rate on any portion of the debt at blended rates of approximately 110 basis points over LIBOR under the variable option and 135 basis points over the corresponding treasury under the fixed option, the company said.
Initially, Mills said it has elected to select a fixed rate on 50 percent of the debt, resulting in a beginning rate of approximately seven percent.
